decisions: T-051, the orchestrator's fix round on the independent review T-050 (findings T050-01 to -04, -07, -08, -09's recording, -11 to -13, -15 to -17). T050-05, -06, -09's rule, -10 and -14 are the user's, and are not here
status: post hoc to docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md and to ml/p1_prereg.json and ml/p1_prereg_2.json, which stand; before any P1 data and before the code it judges. Every number marked [ASSUMPTION] is my choice, labelled, and judges a run's validity, never an arm

generator.findings: T050-03, -04, -16; ml/l7_gen.py, shared with P3 and P4: before any capture
generator.rule: a generator's deadline bounds every kind and every view. No request starts after its end + drain_s, and no wait lasts past it; a think time is cut at its end. A view in flight at the end may finish within drain_s, so a healthy client's last view keeps its rows; a request hanging at end + drain_s is abandoned, and its row written with its error. At end + hard_exit_s the process exits whatever it is doing, with what it has written, and code 0: an arm that banned it did not break it
generator.why: eval/p4_runner.py STOP_GRACE_S, 10 s, still makes a generator alive past it invalid, which now means a stall of the machine, not an arm's ban or a downloader's think time
generator.stream: no draw moves: a cut sleep has already drawn its length

run_validity.findings: T050-07, -08, -11. A run failing one is invalid, with its reason; it is re-run or excluded as any invalid run

enforcing.feed: the largest parsed count of the l7_shadow reports is above 0, and at least parsed_min_share of the file sink's lines; the loss is reported per run (design section 15)
enforcing.parsed_min_share_status: [ASSUMPTION] below it the arm is blind by a fault, not by a live system's ordinary loss, which is the arm's own and stays in the run
enforcing.reload: when the run holds an l7_deny, an l7_reload with ok true follows the first one within reload_within_s, and the last l7_reload up to the run's end is ok
enforcing.reload_within_s_status: [ASSUMPTION] l7_enforce.py RELOAD_MIN_S is 10 s, so this is three chances
enforcing.step_errors: a daemon_error at l7_enforce in the attack window

attack.seen: at least attack_seen_min_share of the run's attack addresses are in the file sink by the attack's end
attack.attack_seen_min_share_status: [ASSUMPTION] every bot's first request precedes any action on it, so a shortfall is a broken run: a source that did not bind, a route, a generator that died

run_validity.file_sink: ml/p1_prereg.json's limit of 10 s on the file sink's silence now reads the benign addresses only, from the attack's start to the run's end, so that an attack's lines cannot hide a stalled benign CPU. At nominal times their silence there is at most 3.8 s on the 18 seeds of p1_pilot and p1_live_eval at any halvings; before the attack it reaches 17.4 s at 2 halvings, which judges nothing
run_validity.timer_gate: before a run, the harm benchmark's gate (bench/executor.py timer_gate) on the legit CPU, at the record's validity.timer_p99_ms, with its wait: a run it refuses starts nothing and is invalid. Its probes go into run.json

one_setting.rule: every block of a campaign has the same record, knees, factor, both selections, point check and code hashes, or the block is refused; the analysis refuses blocks that differ from each other or from its own arguments
one_setting.order: a campaign's order does not read a free label
one_setting.index: a run is in ROOT/index.jsonl before it begins and when it ends; one with no end was a runner's death, and is invalid
one_setting.executor_cpu: the runner keeps to the pin plan's executor CPU (bench/population.PIN_PLAN_DAEMON), off the legit CPU and the server's

ladder.rule: per (class, level, repeat) the harm is the last attempt's with both runs sound; a level none of whose attempts is sound is no harm. A re-run needs a reason: the attempt before it had an invalid run
ladder.knees_file: --ladder writes the file --knees takes, bound to the record and the factor, so that no hand step lies between them
ladder.no_knee: a class without a knee is null in that file, named there, and a campaign that needs it refuses and says so; what it means for the verdict is not decided here

reported.findings: T050-09's recording, T050-11, T050-15; descriptive, judging nothing
reported.server_q: the server-side Q of every live arm's runs, beside Q, per block
reported.health_file: each control's server-side Q, legit CPU share and largest view slip, in the rule's file
reported.view_slip: per run, the largest gap between a device's intended view start and its actual one, with its entity and time: a stall in mid-life shows here, where no validity rule sees it
reported.runner: per run, the largest launch lag and the largest gap of the runner's own loop

late_window.text: Q over [210, 240) s, where arrivals have ended and no source is younger than 30 s, beside the level window's, so that a speed effect can be told from a removal effect

reported.socket_loss: 1 - parsed / the file sink's lines, per enforcing run
